about_the_game:
Note: This product is included in the Season Pass 3. Be careful to avoid making a redundant purchase.

About the content:
The weapon type "Crossed Pike" is added, enabling new actions.
In addition to adding new actions that are shared among characters, unique actions can be achieved by equipping the weapon to officers who favor the weapon type.

▼Added weapon type and officer who favors it
Crossed Pike:Lu Lingqi

▼How to obtain
The new weapons can be purchased at a blacksmith in a city. In addition, they can be crafted by obtaining the corresponding scrolls from a coin collector.

Note: A content set that includes this DLC is also available. Please see the official site for details.
